_readme: S720 (lever), the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever (run 45319725062): 4 programs of Los Angeles Southwest College whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses and for which no page of the 2026-27 catalog holds a section a read could place them from. Free page read 45341735139 printed every page of the catalog PDF the capture reads; the college's other programs on the lever are pinned in its reconcile entry (kb/program_requirements_reconcile.json, pdf_pages). These are filed as named gaps and are never sent to a paid read. Their filed records stay as filed (the load skips a record that places none). No model call, no Supabase write. They are the college's to settle in COCI.

reasons.catalog_list_differs: The 2026-27 catalog prints the program's own section and course list, and the list names fewer than half of the state's listed courses: the Program Course File's list and the catalog's differ, so a read of the section would place too few of them to count.
reasons.noncredit_not_in_catalog: A noncredit program the 2026-27 catalog prints under no heading of its own: its section of noncredit certificates does not name it.
reasons.section_prints_no_list: The 2026-27 catalog prints the program's own section and no course list in it: the state's listed courses print only in the course descriptions.

programs.title: Nursing
programs.note: The Nursing section (PDF pp.117-121) lists its awards, admission steps and the two options, and no course list; NURSING 503A, 503B and 506B print only in the course descriptions (p.215), which the filed record was read from.

programs.title: Liberal Studies (teaching preparation)
programs.note: Its own section, 'ASSOCIATE IN ARTS LIBERAL STUDIES (TEACHING PREPARATION)' (PDF pp.148-149), prints a list of 21 courses to choose 18 units from (ART 103 to POLS C1000) and none of the three the state lists, EDUC 001, 006 and 931; EDUC 001 prints only in the course descriptions (p.194).

programs.title: Job Training Preparation
programs.note: No page prints 'Job Training Preparation'; the noncredit certificates (PDF pp.160-169) do not name it, and BSICSKL 002CE, its one listed course, prints only in the course descriptions (p.175).

programs.title: Workforce Preparation
programs.note: No heading prints 'Workforce Preparation' (p.229's 'workforce preparation' is a course description's sentence); the noncredit certificates (PDF pp.160-169) do not name it, and BSICSKL 002CE prints only in the course descriptions (p.175).
